question: What characteristic mark defines that meditation even in the open-eyed state?
premises: The same condition applies even when the eyes are open.
That meditation has a recognizable defining mark.
The mark persists beyond closed-eye absorption.
inference: Therefore, the defining mark of that meditation remains present even in the state of outward opening.
